classification.method: 30-criterion HCU narrative analysis; largest-remainder normalization to 100
classification.note: Provisional narrative coordinates retained for revision 3; these are neither contribution scores nor measurements of spiritual attainment or human worth.

rationale.HUMAN: First-person mixed motives, fair attribution, payment, care work, consent and rights drive the conflict.
rationale.LIGHT: Digests and review procedures make claims inspectable; a conflict of interest and a linked correction test the founder's own record.
rationale.DARK: Unrecorded lives, uncertain futures, alternative spiritual paths and recursive pride resist total measurement.

unmapped_elements: The recursive attempt to achieve freedom from achievement is only partially represented by the three-center criteria.
Different religious accounts of selfhood and liberation are not reducible to three narrative weights.
The political economy of AI attribution and blockchain governance is not captured by narrative center weights.
coverage_audit.review_note: A human editorial review is pending; classification is provisional.
